title: WireGuard VPN Configuration Runbook
description: Safe configuration procedures for WireGuard VPN with NetworkManager integration
author: AI Agent

expected_results: Routes for VPN and GCP subnets present

operations.name: configure_split_tunneling
operations.description: Configure split tunneling for selective VPN routing

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.peer-routes no
commands.purpose: Disable automatic peer routes for manual control
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.peer-routes yes

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.ip4-auto-default-route no
commands.purpose: Disable automatic default route through VPN
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.ip4-auto-default-route yes

commands.purpose: Add manual routes for VPN and GCP subnets

post_execution_commands: nmcli connection down wg0-et-gtw && nmcli connection up wg0-et-gtw
expected_results: Only VPN and GCP subnets routed through WireGuard
Default route remains on physical interface
Internet access continues through physical interface

operations.name: configure_full_tunnel
operations.description: Configure full tunnel VPN (routes all traffic through VPN)
operations.warning: This will route all internet traffic through VPN. Ensure VPN gateway has internet access and NAT configured.

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.peer-routes no
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.peer-routes yes

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.ip4-auto-default-route yes
commands.purpose: Enable automatic default route through VPN
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.ip4-auto-default-route no

post_execution_commands: nmcli connection down wg0-et-gtw && nmcli connection up wg0-et-gtw

operations.name: configure_dns_for_vpn
operations.description: Configure DNS settings for VPN connection

commands.purpose: Set VPN DNS to Unbound resolver
Set high priority for VPN DNS

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes
commands.purpose: Ignore automatic DNS from VPN peer
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw ipv4.ignore-auto-dns no

post_execution_commands: nmcli connection down wg0-et-gtw && nmcli connection up wg0-et-gtw

operations.name: emergency_rollback
operations.description: Emergency rollback if VPN configuration breaks connectivity

commands.command: nmcli connection modify wg0-et-gtw wireguard.ip4-auto-default-route no

expected_results: VPN connected in split tunnel mode

split_tunnel.description: Only VPN and GCP traffic through VPN, internet through physical interface
split_tunnel.use_case: Normal operation with selective VPN routing

full_tunnel.description: All traffic through VPN (requires gateway internet access)
prerequisites: VPN gateway must have internet access

solutions: Verify peer public key matches gateway

troubleshooting_scenarios.scenario: VPN connects but no internal connectivity
symptoms: VPN interface up but can't reach internal addresses
solutions: Verify routing table includes VPN subnets

symptoms: Internet becomes unreachable when VPN is up
solutions: Check if full tunnel is unintentionally enabled
Verify VPN gateway has internet access

best_practices: Always backup working configurations before changes
Test connectivity after each configuration change
Use split tunneling for normal operations
Only use full tunnel if VPN gateway is properly configured
Monitor systemd-resolved state when changing DNS settings
Document working configurations for quick recovery
Use packet capture for complex routing issues
Keep WireGuard keys secure and never expose them
safety_notes: WireGuard private keys are sensitive - never expose in logs or outputs
Full tunnel VPN can break internet if gateway not configured properly
DNS configuration changes can affect system-wide resolution
Always have emergency rollback procedures ready
Monitor system logs after configuration changes

integration_with_runbook_toolkit.usage: Use this runbook with the runbook toolkit for safe execution

example_plan.goal: Configure WireGuard split tunneling with DNS
